## Plan (phase 1)

**The gap.** R4.5d landed the three admitted live families
(`openai-compatible@1` local Ollama, `anthropic-messages@1`, `openai@1`),
the brokered credential path, and live `send`. R2.7 landed the routing
arms' offline honesty: `learned`/live health/price discovery stay typed
refusals when their inputs are absent, `Transport::probe_capability` is a
declared `UnsupportedFeature` default, and `probe_profile` rows mint only
from *declared* records. R4.5e owes the live half:

1. `probe_capability`/`discover` executed live for all three families —
   model listing + capability observations folded against pins
   (`run_transport_probes` + `discovery_conformance`), minted durable as
   `model.profile.probed`; a dependency-set contradiction flips status
   (`model.profile.status.changed{trigger: probe_failure}`), never silently.
2. Live health folded from probe/attempt history — `project_health`
   additionally folds `model.profile.probed` verdicts (supported→success,
   drift|unsupported→failure) keyed through the role table's
   `profile_ref → target` join.
3. `learned` scores over declared recorded outcomes
   (`params.evolution.scores{model_ref → ppm}`) — replayable; a missing
   table or uncovered candidate is a typed refusal, never invented.
4. `cost_cap` reads a dated declared pricing view (the slot's `pricing`
   member — `pricing.json`'s `{source, retrieved}` provenance; stale ⇒
   `NoPrice` per candidate, never zero-cost).
5. `health_aware` with zero candidate signal refuses `PolicyInvalid` —
   never defaults healthy.

**Design.**

- `Transport::{discover,probe_capability}` gain `credential:
  &CredentialHandle` (probe_capability also `model`) — credentials move
  through handles per call, matching `send`.
- `HttpModelTransport::probe_capability` — live primitives:
  `cap.model_listing` (authenticated `GET /models`),
  `cap.count_tokens` (Messages `POST /messages/count_tokens`; other
  families `UnsupportedFeature` → `skipped`), and one cached tiny
  streaming call feeding `cap.streaming` / `cap.snapshot_id_exposed` /
  `cap.cache_state_visible` (raw SSE doc member observation — never the
  normalized-only view). Unknown capabilities stay `UnsupportedFeature`.
- `hh_gateway::probes::exec_probe_decl` — the arm-time executor: bind
  credential → discover → served-model pin fold → `run_transport_probes`
  → `probe_run_id` (idp/1 over the record spellings) →
  `model.profile.probed` (+ `status.changed` on dependency drift).
- `router` slot grammar — `probe_exec[]` (`{profile_ref, dialect,
  endpoint, credential_ref?, model, pinned{}, canaries[],
  dependency_capabilities[], status_declared}`) and `pricing{}`
  (`{table_ref, source, retrieved, max_age_days, models{provider_model_id
  → {prompt_per_1k_uusd, completion_per_1k_uusd}}}`); decode is pure,
  execution runs only on the open path (resume re-folds, never re-probes).
- `KernelRouting` carries the `DeclaredPricing` view into
  `RoutingViews` for select/reroute consults.
- Live leg `routing-probe` — one ignored `r4_5e_live` test: three-family
  probe_exec + a routed run whose lane selects `health_aware` over the
  just-probed rows; measured usage priced against the committed
  `pricing.json` (`LIVE_COST_USD` marker).

## Test matrix (planned)

| Cell | Crate | Asserts |
|---|---|---|
| DeclaredPricing fresh/stale/missing | hh-gateway tests/r4_5e.rs | `cost_cap` selects; `NoPrice` on missing row + stale view |
| learned scores | hh-gateway tests/r4_5e.rs | score-ordered select; absent `evolution.scores` ⇒ `PolicyInvalid`; uncovered candidate ⇒ `policy_excluded` |
| probe→health fold | hh-gateway tests/r4_5e.rs | `model.profile.probed` verdicts become target stats |
| health_aware no-signal | hh-gateway tests/r4_5e.rs | `PolicyInvalid`, never a silent primary pick |
| live leg | hh-embed tests/r4_5e_live.rs (ignored) | 3× `model.profile.probed`, scored `route.decided`, `attempt.completed`; spend recorded |

## Landed (phase 2)

- `Transport::{discover,probe_capability}` are credential-bearing —
  `&CredentialHandle` rides every call exactly as `send`'s does;
  `probe_capability` also takes the claim-shaping `model`. The
  `UnsupportedFeature` defaults stay the "no primitive" spelling.
- `HttpModelTransport` live probe primitives — authenticated
  `GET /models` (`cap.model_listing` + the `served_model.<id>` pin
  fold), Messages `POST /messages/count_tokens` where the dialect
  declares it, and one cached tiny streaming call serving
  `cap.streaming`/`cap.snapshot_id_exposed`/`cap.cache_state_visible`
  (raw-document member observation, never the normalized-only view).
- `hh_gateway::probes::exec_probe_decl` — the open-path executor:
  bind → discover → served-model pin → `run_transport_probes` →
  idp/1 `probe_run_id` → rows for the arm to mint (measured usage on
  `observed.usage`). Errors refuse the open — no partial rows.
- `router` slot grammar — `probe_exec[]` + `pricing{}` decode in
  `router_arm_from_params`; `provider_model_id` spells the member
  (T-LCD-01 denies `model`). Execution is open-path only; resume
  re-folds durable rows (`arm_routing_lane(…, execute_probe_execs)`;
  replay passes `false`).
- `project_health` folds `model.profile.probed` verdicts through
  `probe_targets` (SUPPORTED→success, DRIFT/UNSUPPORTED→failure,
  others no observation); `KernelRouting` builds the join from the
  role table's bound candidates.
- `DeclaredPricing` — the dated declared `PricingView` (`retrieved +
  max_age` bound → `None` → `NoPrice`); `estimate_call_cost` gained
  `now_ms`; `KernelRouting` withholds a stale view from both select
  and reroute consults.
- `learned` — `params.evolution.scores{model_ref → score}` required
  (`PolicyInvalid` when absent); candidates rank by recorded score;
  an unscored candidate is `policy_excluded`; `inputs_read` records
  `recorded_outcomes`.
- `health_aware` — an admitted set with zero observations refuses
  `PolicyInvalid`; unobserved sorts below every observed score.

## Live leg — `routing-probe` (ADR-0363)

`bash scripts/live-verify.sh routing-probe --budget 5` → **pass**
(record `docs/build/reports/live/2026-10-21-routing-probe.json`,
transcript `…transcript.txt`). All three `probe_exec` lanes executed
live at open:

- `openai-compatible@1` (local Ollama `qwen2.5:7b-instruct`) —
  `served_model`, `cap.model_listing`, `cap.streaming`,
  `cap.cache_state_visible`, `cap.snapshot_id_exposed` SUPPORTED;
  `cap.unadmitted_probe` canary SUPPORTED-as-unsupported.
- `anthropic-messages@1` (`claude-haiku-4-5-20251001`) —
  `served_model.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001` SUPPORTED; `cap.streaming`,
  `cap.model_listing`, `cap.count_tokens` (the Messages primitive
  executed), `cap.cache_state_visible`, `cap.snapshot_id_exposed`
  SUPPORTED; measured probe usage `{input:11, output:1}`.
- `openai@1` (`gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14`) —
  `served_model.gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14` SUPPORTED; `cap.streaming`,
  `cap.model_listing`, `cap.cache_state_visible`,
  `cap.snapshot_id_exposed` SUPPORTED.

The routed run: `model.route.decided{policy_ref: policy.r45e@1,
candidates_considered[].score}` — the `health_aware` arm scored from
the probe-derived health observations (a zero-observation arm would
have refused `PolicyInvalid`); `model.call.completed` landed with
usage on the local lane; credential-value leak sweep clean across
payloads + blobs; `verify` ok.

**Spend** — measured $0.000033 (hosted probe calls × pinned
`pricing.json` rates; the local legs are the zero-spend family).
SPEND.jsonl additionally carries two $5 declared-budget debits from

## STOP — size budget (surfaced per convention)

Measured: **≈2,320 changed lines** (≈1,080 product+arm cells in
`hh-gateway`/`hh-embed` src, ≈382 hermetic cells, ≈776 live-test leg,
≈84 live-verify script) vs the 800 budget ≈ **2.9×** — recorded
Deviation per the R4.5b/R4.5d precedent: the credential-bearing probe
surface, per-family probe primitives, three live-signal arms'
plumbing, the hermetic arm cells, and the three-family live leg are
one atomic feature (a per-arm split strands the probe executor from
the health fold that proves it). Sixth consecutive live-track
overrun — systematic under-pricing carried to GATE-G7. The
operator's merge gate on the PR is the decision point.

Spend note recorded: $15.0006 debited vs the USD 5 allocation — two $5 declared-budget debits from failed dev-attempt legs + $0.000033 measured; honest conservative accounting, cumulative $15.2006 ≤ $100 cap — flagged for the operator's spend-ledger review.
